name: Complex numbers
description: Complex functions over the complex plane: Domain Colouring shows f(z) as colour, the argument as hue and the modulus as lightness, so zeros, poles and branch cuts can be seen; Complex Path follows a path z(t), or its image f(z(t)), coloured by t; Riemann Surface draws all the values of z^(p/q) or log z as one surface.
author: ChartLibre
